=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1932-1948 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The head_unverified refusal checks only the original RB_ACTION, so a merge or merge_with_followup that rb_security_severity_block later converts to fix (RB_ACTION="fix") skips the unreadable-head refusal.
  WHY: The converted fix pushes to TARGET_BRANCH (line 2487) without the --match-head-commit binding, so it acts on a head that was never verified as live (the BUG-001 scenario). Severity is MAJOR in the reviewers that stated one (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash). google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite stated none.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1923-1931 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The stale_head check requires the live PR head to equal RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA (line 1323, the local checkout HEAD). That HEAD can legitimately be ahead of the live head when conflict resolution committed [ai-merge-resolve] locally and the push is deferred until after the judge step.
  WHY: The judge decision is discarded and an LLM call is wasted on conflicted-PR runs. The reviewer suggests an ancestry check (git merge-base --is-ancestor) instead of equality. Another reviewer (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5) considered this concern and chose not to report it.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:30-75 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The JUDGE_SKIP_REASON case (and the Telegram case in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5208-5250) has no arm for stale_head or head_unverified.
  WHY: Both reasons fall through to the generic "needs human intervention" comment and alert, although stale_head recovers on its own via the next synchronize run. The files are outside the issue's files_touched, so this is a follow-up candidate. Severity is NIT in the reviewers that stated one.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5

RB_SECURITY_FORCED_FIX is set but never consulted by a head check, there is no post-conversion head check, and tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py does not exercise the security-conversion path.
- requirement: "Follow the style of the existing `merged_pr_unsafe_action` skip right below the guard. Check that `stale_head` is not already used as a skip reason."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:30-75 and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml around lines 5208-5250 (case arms for the new skip reasons)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither case statement has an arm for stale_head or head_unverified, so each new skip routes to the generic human-intervention body and a Telegram CRITICAL.

  WHY: With RB_LIVE_HEAD_SHA empty and open high/critical security findings, the fix path continues for a head that was never confirmed as live. The reviewer suggests repeating the empty check inside the convert_fix) arm, or moving the check below the severity block.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:30-75 and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5208-5250 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: case "${JUDGE_SKIP_REASON:-}" has no arm for stale_head or head_unverified.
  WHY: Each stale-head skip posts a misleading human-action comment and Telegram alert. Both files are outside the issue's files_touched, so this is a follow-up candidate.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: In the convert_fix) arm (line 1945), if RB_LIVE_HEAD_SHA is empty and PR_ALREADY_MERGED is not "true", write judge_action=skip and judge_skip_reason=head_unverified to GITHUB_OUTPUT and exit 0. Add a test for it. About 5 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1932-1935, 1942-1948, 2487 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The unreadable-head guard checks the original RB_ACTION before security handling can convert a merge action to fix.
  WHY: When the PR metadata read fails, RB_LIVE_HEAD_SHA is empty. With RB_SECURITY_MODE=true, blocking findings and IS_FINAL=false, merge or merge_with_followup becomes fix after the guard. The fix path then runs git push origin HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH} without the --match-head-commit binding, so an unverified live head can be updated.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:30-74 (consumer at .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4513-4529 and 5208-5249) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The existing exhaustion handlers do not recognize the new stale_head skip reason.
  WHY: stale_head falls through to the generic "needs human intervention" message and the default CRITICAL Telegram alert, although the new head's synchronize run is the automatic re-review path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  WHY: In the narrow window of a final-round merge with blocking security findings and a failed guard PR read, the converted fix commits and pushes to TARGET_BRANCH without the --match-head-commit binding. That is the BUG-001 scenario via the security-conversion path.
